Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Pb centers coordinated by six Br neighbors, while Y centers show a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 Br neighbors. K centers display a 12-neighbor environment, and the neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Pb octahedra and face-sharing between Pb octahedra and Y or K polyhedra.
